note: Only rates verified on official issuer or government pages on 2026-11-26. Thursday, November 26, 2026 is Thanksgiving; Treasury did not publish a new daily bill-rate file (latest quotes remain 2026-11-25) and there were no new bill auctions. Promotional 'up to' offers and pages that did not print a number were omitted. No affiliate links. Popular Direct Plus Savings remains 4.25% APY, $5,000 new-money minimum, effective 2026-11-23. Where an official page still carried an older as-of date (SoFi rate sheet October 20, Schwab Intelligent Portfolios Sweep November 2, FDIC national average November 16, Ally rates November 24, Fidelity SPAXX and Vanguard VMFXX November 24, and several bank pages November 25), the existing rate and as-of date were kept. Sallie Mae's high-yield savings page still shows 4.00% APY but prints 'accurate as of 11/27/2026', a future date relative to this verification, so the prior 2026-11-25 as-of date was kept. Bread Savings still shows 4.05% APY but only an unfilled 'accurate as of today' placeholder, so 2026-11-25 was kept.

hysa.notes: Table 4 of the SoFi Bank rate sheet. Without eligible direct deposit, $5,000 qualifying deposits every 31 days, or SoFi Plus, the savings APY is 0.80%. SoFi Plus tier (up to 4.70% on the first $20,000) is a paid membership and is not this row.

hysa.notes: Standard APY. A separate 3-month referral boost of 1.00% is not included. No minimum deposit.

hysa.name: Synchrony Bank High Yield Savings
hysa.notes: ProductId 100, 3.75% APY on every balance tier in Synchrony's retail products API, which the public rate page loads. The public High Yield Savings page, titled November 2026 Rates, prints 3.75% APY and states that all APYs are accurate as of 11/21/2026.

hysa.notes: Variable rate. Issuer says available only online. No fees stated on the homepage offer.

hysa.name: Popular Direct Plus Savings
hysa.notes: Popular Bank product that replaced Select Savings. $5,000 minimum opening deposit in new money. Issuer page lists 4.25% APY and 4.162% interest rate, effective Thursday, November 19, 2026. Rate may change at any time.

hysa.name: Sallie Mae High-Yield Savings
hysa.notes: Personal accounts. Variable. Footnote on the issuer page ties this APY to the high-yield savings account. The same footnote printed 'accurate as of 11/23/2026', a date after this check, so the as-of date is the verification date 2026-11-21.

hysa.name: Bread Savings High-Yield Savings
hysa.notes: Issuer disclosure says Bread Savings APYs are accurate as of 11/25/2026. The high-yield savings APY on the page is 4.05%.

hysa.name: Happen Bank LevelUp Savings — LevelUp rate
hysa.notes: Requires at least $250 in cumulative deposits during the evaluation period (previous statement cycle). Otherwise the standard 3.00% APY applies. LevelUp rate accurate as of 11/20/2026.
